title: Cross-Source Investigation · An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Separate sources
scenes.purpose: Present three labelled source records one at a time, deliberately unaligned, on a dark case-file desk.
visuals: Timeline axis draws left to right
SRC A NOTEBOOK, SRC B WHITEBOARD, SRC C SERVER LOG cards rise in at loose tilted positions; labels, timestamps and locations appear only after each card lands

beats.development: Heading, disclaimer and shared chronology axis appear.
captions: CASE FILE · AN IDEA BECOMES A CONNECTED SYSTEM

beats.development: Cards A, B and C arrive separately (0.15, 0.45, 0.75 s), each revealing its source label, timestamp, claim and location after landing.

scenes.title: Synchronise
scenes.purpose: Snap all three records onto the common chronology.
visuals: Cards straighten and slide into aligned positions above their dates
Dashed drop lines, tick dots and DAY 01 / 09 / 21 labels appear

beats.development: Cards align to the timeline; each card is tied to its date by a drop line.

scenes.title: Convergence and hold
scenes.purpose: Draw the three sources converging on one event and hold the conclusion with its supporting cards.
visuals: Blue strands draw from each card to the convergence card; ports appear on arrival (no arrowheads)
Gold-bordered MATCH · DAY 30 card scales in; A/B/C ports, spokes and gold node reveal after the card is complete
Gold DAY 30 tick and label mark the converging fact

beats.development: Strands converge; conclusion card and its traced A+B+C contents resolve; DAY 30 marked in the shared gold emphasis.
Settled hold of the convergence with all supporting cards visible.

findings: Sources enter 0.3 s apart so each is seen separately before the 0.4 s synchronisation move.
justifiedHolds: 2.55–3.00 s: style requires holding the convergence moment with its supporting cards.

notes: No preview_recipes in STYLE.json; demonstrates the primary characteristic action.
Every on-screen claim carries a source label, timestamp and location; records are illustrative.
